claims.claim: Manipur’s Cabinet approved a one-time payment of 10 lakh rupees each for the kin of 49 people missing since the ethnic conflict that began on 3 May 2023.
claims.episode_span: approved a one-time payment of ₹10 lakh for the kin of each of 49 people missing since the ethnic conflict that began on 3 May 2023
claims.source_title: Kin of Manipur’s 49 people missing since 2023 ethnic conflict to get ₹10 lakh each
claims.supporting_quote: The Manipur Cabinet has approved a one-time financial assistance of ₹10 lakh each for the kin of 49 people missing since the ethnic conflict erupted in the State on May 3, 2023.

claims.claim: Home Minister Konthoujam Govindas told the Assembly in September that the conflicts claimed 306 lives and displaced more than 60,000 people.
claims.episode_span: claimed 306 lives and displaced more than 60,000 people
claims.source_title: Kin of Manipur’s 49 people missing since 2023 ethnic conflict to get ₹10 lakh each
claims.supporting_quote: Manipur’s Home Minister Konthoujam Govindas told the 60-member House in September that the conflicts — first between the Kuki-Zo and Meitei communities and then between the Kukis and Nagas — claimed 306 lives and displaced more than 60,000 people.

claims.claim: The law presumes a missing person dead only after seven years.

claims.source_title: Kin of Manipur’s 49 people missing since 2023 ethnic conflict to get ₹10 lakh each
claims.supporting_quote: The law says a missing person is presumed dead only after seven years.

claims.claim: Revised ex-gratia for Army and CAPF personnel in Manipur will be 10 lakh rupees for death, 2 lakh for permanent disability, 1 lakh for grievous injury and 20,000 for simple injury, replacing 2006 rates of 2 lakh for death and 10,000 for injury.

claims.supporting_quote: The revised compensation will be ₹10 lakh for death, ₹2 lakh for permanent disability, ₹1 lakh for grievous injury, and ₹20,000 for simple injury.

claims.claim: Deandra Kontou, 32, was charged last week with nine offences over alleged abuse of a teenage student spanning six months.

claims.supporting_quote: Deandra Kontou, 32, was last week charged with nine offences over the alleged abuse spanning six months, in which she allegedly exposed the teenage boy to indecent material, groomed him through online messages, coerced him into a sex act without his consent, and twice sexually touched him.

claims.claim: Kontou is accused of sexually assaulting the student between 10 p.m. and 11 p.m. on a Fitzroy Island camp.
claims.episode_span: sexually assaulting him between 10 p.m. and 11 p.m.
claims.source_title: How the alleged Newington College rape was exposed
claims.supporting_quote: The alleged abuse continued on a senior camp to Fitzroy Island on the Great Barrier Reef, where Kontou is accused of twice sexually touching the child during the day, before sexually assaulting him between 10pm and 11pm.
